$Comment: The spot the Headless Horseman rides in from, in the saddle (Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted). It stands in his graveyard's prefab as a marker entity beside his fight's own entity, so every fresh copy of the graveyard brings a fresh one. ManualTrigger means it never spawns him on its own: only his fight's script raises him, when players come near, and only while his last spawn is gone. RealtimeRespawn and RealtimeRespawnTime are the respawn form every marker must write; a marker that only fires on request never reads them. DeactivationDistance and DeactivationTime are wide so he is never packed back into the marker mid-fight.
